publicComments.name: Maria Stockton
publicComments.summary: Spoke on behalf of classified employees asking the board to more visibly recognize and show sensitivity toward the essential work classified staff have performed during the pandemic, noting that prior risk pay acknowledgment has not continued and that instructional assistants are not being compensated equally for doing the same work as teachers.
